name: Dafy V-Integra Renal homemade diet balancer
note: Phosphorus-free vitamin-mineral balancer for home-made diets needing phosphorus restriction (dogs and cats). Vegetarian: no animal-derived ingredients (manufacturer); carriers are maize starch, maltodextrin and vegetable oils; vitamin D3 source not stated (D3 is often from lanolin - vegetarian, not vegan). Label: Ca 15.1%, P 0%, Na 1.4%, K 7.5%, Mg 1.1%, protein 6.9%, fat 2.6%, ash 62.5%, moisture 2.3%, lysine 0.1%. Composition: calcium carbonate, potassium carbonate, maize starch, maltodextrin, magnesium carbonate, vegetable oils and fats, sodium chloride, sodium bicarbonate. Per kg: vit A 250,000 IU, D3 25,000 IU, B1 120 mg, B2 250 mg, B6 50 mg, B12 1.5 mg, C 1,250 mg, K3 10 mg, niacin 500 mg, Ca pantothenate 450 mg, folic acid 9.8 mg, biotin 2.5 mg, choline chloride 50,000 mg (= ~37,300 mg choline), taurine 40,000 mg, Fe 2,550 mg, Cu 250 mg, Mn 100 mg, Zn 4,500 mg, I 45 mg, Se 5.5 mg. No vitamin E declared (tocopherols only as antioxidant). Calcium is mostly carbonate - given with the meal it also binds some phosphorus (not counted here). Label dose: dog 6-10 kg 5-8 g/day (1-5 kg 2-4 g); scoop = 5 g; add just before feeding. Energy estimated. Source: dafynutrition.com/products/v-integra-renal.
